items.title: PostgreSQL 19 Released
items.snippet: PostgreSQL 19 Released Most years PostgreSQL ships a new release in September, but this year's release came two months later thanks mainly to the flurry of issues that the PostgreSQL team needed to address as part of the ongoing AI-reported vulnerability apocalypse. This release was definitely worth the wait. My favorite new feature is this one: For applications that send reads to standbys, PostgreSQL 19 adds "read-your-writes" consistency with the new WAIT FOR LSN command. A session on a standb
items.title_ar: إصدار PostgreSQL 19 مع read-your-writes على standbys
items.summary_ar: صدر PostgreSQL 19 متأخراً شهرين عن موعده المعتاد بسبب معالجة ثغرات أبلغت عنها أدوات AI. أبرز الميزات أمر WAIT FOR LSN الذي يضيف read-your-writes consistency لقراءات الجلسات على standby servers.
items.why_ar: PostgreSQL من قواعد البيانات الأساسية في الأنظمة المصرفية، وميزة الاتساق على standbys قابلة للتجربة فوراً.
items.title_en: PostgreSQL 19 released with read-your-writes on standbys
items.summary_en: PostgreSQL 19 shipped two months later than usual, mainly to address vulnerabilities reported by AI tools. Its headline feature is the WAIT FOR LSN command, which adds read-your-writes consistency for session reads sent to standby servers.
items.why_en: PostgreSQL underpins many banking systems, and the new standby consistency feature can be tested immediately.

items.title: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
items.snippet: Peer review relies on several readers finding different problems. We measure critique overlap in conference and journal reviews. At ICLR, measured overlap rose from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027, in reviews from the same stage of the review process, with year-on-year rises at NeurIPS, ICML and the F1000 and PLOS journals. A third ICLR review of a paper added 5.46 new problems to the other two in 2027, against 6.12 in 2026. We apply MELD, a detector of LLM-generated text, to all reviews. Within a paper, two reviews that MELD flags overlap more than two unflagged reviews: by 3.0 points at ICLR in 2024-2025, by 4.5 points in 2026-2027, and by 5.4 points across five journal sources. These resul
items.title_ar: تجانس النقد في مراجعة الأقران في عصر LLM
items.summary_ar: تقيس الدراسة مدى تداخل الملاحظات في مراجعات المؤتمرات والمجلات، وتجد أن التداخل في ICLR ارتفع من 12.0% في 2026 إلى 21.3% في 2027. كما تستخدم أداة MELD للكشف عن نصوص LLM وتربط المراجعات المُعلّمة بتداخل أعلى.
items.why_ar: مفيد إذا كنت تكتب أبحاثاً للنشر، لأنه يكشف أثر LLM على استقلالية مراجعة الأقران ويقدم منهجية قياس قابلة للتكرار.
items.title_en: Claim-level homogenization of peer review in the LLM era
items.summary_en: The study measures critique overlap across conference and journal reviews, finding it rose at ICLR from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027. Using the MELD LLM-text detector, it shows reviews flagged as LLM-generated overlap more than unflagged ones.
items.why_en: As you publish research, this reveals how LLM use may be eroding the independence of peer review.

items.title: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
items.snippet: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks. However, it is unknown how dedicated training of these networks can contribute to the successes of weight-space programming. We present a benchmark of LLM-driven weight-space programming on vision models, in which five LLMs edit convolutional networks and vision transformers on relabeling and error-correction tasks on Waterbirds, CIFAR-100, PACS and Entity-30. We report more than 2,600 such edit processes, whereby each edit is scored on held-out images for success, side effects and accuracy loss. We compare standard training with la
items.title_ar: تدريب vision models لدعم LLM-driven weight-space programming
items.summary_ar: تقدم الدراسة benchmark يقيس weight-space programming على vision models، حيث تعدّل خمسة LLMs شبكات convolutional وvision transformers في مهام إعادة الوسم وتصحيح الأخطاء. تُقيَّم أكثر من 2,600 عملية تعديل من حيث النجاح والآثار الجانبية وخسارة الدقة، وتُقارن فيها طرق التدريب القياسية بالمخصصة.
items.why_ar: إذا كنت تبحث في model editing أو تعديل الشبكات عبر LLM، فالدراسة توفر إطار تقييم قابلاً للتكرار في بحثك.
items.title_en: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
items.summary_en: The paper presents a benchmark of LLM-driven weight-space programming on vision models. Five LLMs edit CNNs and vision transformers on relabeling and error-correction tasks across Waterbirds, CIFAR-100, PACS and Entity-30, with over 2,600 edits scored for success, side effects and accuracy loss.
items.why_en: It offers a reproducible evaluation framework for model editing that is directly applicable to your research work.

items.title: Accelerating Mixture of Block Attention via Dynamic Routing, KV-Centric Execution and Runtime Pipelining
items.snippet: Mixture of Block Attention (MoBA) reduces long-context computation by selecting key-value (KV) blocks for each query. FlashMoBA implements MoBA efficiently but retains a fixed Top-k budget and query-centric schedule. Fixed Top-k applies one budget across different score distributions and couples routing to task granularity; query-range ownership fragments K/V reuse when several ranges select the same column. We present LightningMoBA, which co-designs selection and execution through dynamic routing, KV-centric ownership, and runtime pipelining. Dynamic routing thresholds MoBA's per-query block scores and directly emits variable-cardinality sparse metadata. KV-centric ownership groups selected
items.title_ar: LightningMoBA يسرّع Mixture of Block Attention عبر dynamic routing
items.summary_ar: يقدم البحث LightningMoBA تحسيناً لتقنية MoBA التي تقلل حساب long-context attention عبر اختيار KV blocks لكل query. يستبدل الباحثون الـ Top-k الثابت بتوجيه ديناميكي يعتمد على عتبة لدرجات الـ blocks، ويعيد تنظيم التنفيذ حول KV-centric ownership مع runtime pipelining. الهدف هو تقليل تكرار قراءة K/V وتحسين كفاءة التنفيذ.
items.why_ar: يهم مهندس AI لأنه يمس كفاءة inference للسياقات الطويلة في نماذج LLM، وهي نقطة مهمة عند بناء حلول داخلية تعتمد على نصوص طويلة.
items.title_en: LightningMoBA accelerates Mixture of Block Attention via dynamic routing
items.summary_en: The LightningMoBA paper improves MoBA, a method that reduces long-context attention cost by selecting KV blocks per query. It replaces the fixed Top-k budget with dynamic thresholding of block scores and reorganizes execution around KV-centric ownership with runtime pipelining. The goal is to reduce repeated K/V access and improve execution efficiency.
items.why_en: It matters for AI engineers working on long-context inference efficiency in LLM-based internal solutions.

items.title: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
items.snippet: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges and graders to replace human annotators, raising the question of when such replacement is statistically justified. To support such decisions, the Alternative Annotator Test (Alt-Test) was introduced for dense settings where all items are annotated by the same annotators. However, in many large-scale annotation settings, items are annotated by different subsets of annotators. We therefore propose the Alternative Annotator Test with Resampled Annotations (AltRA-Test), a statistical test that does not require that all items are annotated by the same annotators. AltRA-Test uses a bootstrap that resamples items, draws k human annotation
items.title_ar: AltRA-Test: اختبار LLM judges بدون مُعلّقين مشتركين
items.summary_ar: يتناول البحث متى يكون استبدال المحكّم البشري بـ LLM judges مبرراً إحصائياً. يوسّع الباحثون Alt-Test ليعمل حين لا يُعلّق نفس المُعلّقين على كل العناصر، عبر AltRA-Test الذي يستخدم bootstrap مع إعادة أخذ عينات من العناصر وسحب annotations بشرية من مجموعات فرعية.
items.why_ar: إذا كنت تستخدم LLM كـ grader لتقييم مخرجات الأنظمة، فهذا يعطيك طريقة إحصائية لتبرير ذلك.
items.title_en: AltRA-Test: Testing LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
items.summary_en: The paper studies when replacing human annotators with LLM judges is statistically justified. It extends the Alternative Annotator Test to settings where different subsets of annotators label different items. AltRA-Test uses a bootstrap that resamples items and draws human annotations from subsets.
items.why_en: If you use LLMs as graders for evaluating system outputs, this gives a statistical basis for that decision.

items.title: TwinD: Generalizing Deepfake Detection from Blending to Entire Face Synthesis
items.snippet: Facial deepfake detectors are usually trained on blending fakes, where a generated face is pasted back into a real frame. Recent generators synthesize the entire face and leave no traces of blending. On a benchmark of 19 datasets released from 2019 to 2026, the best prior facial deepfake detector reaches a mean AUROC of 96.2% on ten blending datasets, but none exceeds 78.1% on five datasets of entire face synthesis (EFS). AI-generated content (AIGC) detectors do not close this gap. We propose TwinD, a detector trained on FaceForensics++ fakes and two kinds of twins: fakes made from a real frame. A reconstruction twin is a real frame reconstructed by an autoencoder, with the real pixels put b
items.title_ar: TwinD: تعميم كشف deepfake ليشمل Entire Face Synthesis
items.summary_ar: تُدرَّب أدوات كشف deepfake للوجوه عادةً على blending fakes، لكنها تضعف على الموديلات الحديثة التي تولّد الوجه كاملاً. في benchmark من 19 dataset، بلغ أفضل detector سابق متوسط AUROC يقارب 96.2% على blending datasets، ولم يتجاوز 78.1% على خمس datasets من Entire Face Synthesis. تقترح الورقة TwinD، وهو detector يُدرَّب على FaceForensics++ مع reconstruction twins مبنية من إطارات حقيقية.
items.why_ar: كشف الوجوه المزيفة مهم لعمليات التحقق من الهوية عن بُعد في البنوك، وهذه الورقة توضح فجوة واضحة في الأدوات الحالية.
items.title_en: TwinD: Generalizing Deepfake Detection to Entire Face Synthesis
items.summary_en: Facial deepfake detectors are usually trained on blending fakes and struggle with recent generators that synthesize the entire face. On a 19-dataset benchmark, the best prior detector reaches 96.2% mean AUROC on blending datasets but none exceeds 78.1% on five EFS datasets. The paper proposes TwinD, trained on FaceForensics++ fakes plus reconstruction twins made from real frames.
items.why_en: Robust face deepfake detection matters for remote identity verification and fraud prevention in banking.

items.title: HiUni: Harmonizing Understanding and Generation in Shared Visual Space
items.snippet: Unified multimodal models aim to support visual understanding and generation within a single framework. However, prevailing approaches often separate their visual representations or backbone computation to accommodate the different requirements of these two tasks, which limits the degree of unification. In this paper, we present HiUni, which revisits this design choice and explores whether a pretrained vision language model can be directly extended into a unified model with extensive parameter sharing.
